buildStep.cmd: cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 > /tmp/vc-meta.json 2>&1 && echo META-OK || echo META-FAIL

evaluatorEntrypoints.scene-integrity: miss=0; total=0; for f in $(grep -rhoE 'path="res://[^"]+"' xr-client --include='*.tscn' --include='*.tres' | sed 's/path="res:\/\///;s/"$//' | sort -u); do total=$((total+1)); [ -e "xr-client/$f" ] || { miss=$((miss+1)); echo "MISSING: $f"; }; done; echo "refs: $total missing: $miss"
evaluatorEntrypoints.cargo-manifest: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('/tmp/vc-meta.json')); pk=[p['name'] for p in m['packages']]; print('crates:', len(pk)); print('xr-presence:', 'visionclaw-xr-presence' in pk)"
evaluatorEntrypoints.action-map: echo "openxr actions: $(grep -c OpenXRAction xr-client/openxr_action_map.tres)"; test -s xr-client/openxr_action_map.tres && echo MAP-OK || echo MAP-MISSING

extraDisciplines: xr-first: the promoted surfaces are the Godot xr-client (scenes, scripts, openxr action map) and the Rust XR crates (visionclaw-xr-presence wire protocol, gpu physics actors, socket_flow position updates). Weight these above general repo concerns.

no-heavy-builds: full cargo check/test of the workspace is too heavy for the annexe night — reason from the manifest, source, and the light evaluators above; propose (not run) targeted builds as HANDOFF notes.
agentbox-is-upstream: the agentbox/ submodule is owned by its own repo and dream roster history — fence it out; record cross-repo findings as 'HANDOFF (agentbox):' notes.
on-device-validation: VIVE Pro desktop OpenXR is the live validation path (ADR-136); headset-dependent claims cannot be evidenced in the annexe — mark them 'HANDOFF (vive):'.
